options.blogdescription: Small-batch ceramics from the Cornish coast

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$o = get_option( 'jamies_header_effects_options', array() );
if ( ! is_array( $o ) ) { $o = array(); }
$o = array_merge( $o, array(
	'enabled'             => true,
	'background_style'    => 'chameleon',
	'overlay_content'     => true,
	'push_content_down'   => false,
	'hide_on_scroll_down' => false,
	'reveal_on_scroll_up' => true,
	'sticky_bg_opacity'   => 0.96,
	'transition_speed_ms' => 450,
	'admin_bar_offset'    => true,
) );
update_option( 'jamies_header_effects_options', $o );

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$content = base64_decode( '' );
$id = wp_insert_post( array(
	'post_type'    => 'page',
	'post_status'  => 'publish',
	'post_title'   => 'Home',
	'post_name'    => 'home',
	'post_content' => $content,
) );
if ( $id && ! is_wp_error( $id ) ) {
	update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
	update_option( 'page_on_front', $id );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_wp_page_template', 'page-no-title' );
}
